mentions.name: Unskip
mentions.description: This web service lets website owners add troll CAPTCHA challenges to their sites or create redirects via shortened links. It is a fun novelty project for people who enjoy watching visitors solve pranked CAPTCHAs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on a website that lets you add any form of troll CAPTCHA to your website or allows you to create a redirection with shortened link.
